selection.rule: Sort SHA256(seed + '|' + basename(audio.path)) ascending, then basename. Select first 64 unique audio filenames from publisher test, without transcript/duration/outcome filtering.

audio.representation: Deterministically decode publisher bytes and re-encode all selected clips as PCM s16 mono WAV 16000Hz. No crop, denoise, loudness normalization or augmentation.
audio.invalidOrOversizePolicy: Retain selected record, count recognition failure as empty hypothesis in all-sample WER/CER. Never replace a failed sample.

scoring.normalization: Unicode NFKC, lowercase, replace Unicode punctuation and symbols with spaces, collapse whitespace; preserve letters, digits and diacritics; do not expand numbers or repair words.
scoring.wer: sum word Levenshtein distance / sum reference words, no clipping; rejected/error hypotheses are empty
scoring.cer: sum character Levenshtein distance / sum reference characters after removing whitespace, no clipping
scoring.latency: Sequential cold subprocess per clip through production adapter, includes Python/model load and inference; excludes file preparation, browser, microphone, HTTP and one-time availability check.

verification.repeatSelection: First eight records in the frozen hash order, never selected by output quality. Identical transcripts may be claimed only for this repeated subset.

limitations: Small deterministic sample of public read speech, not a full FLEURS test result or a business-order benchmark.
No fine-tuning or model selection. Pretraining overlap with public speech/text cannot be ruled out.
No owner consent, microphone study, menu/quantity/negation labels or operational accuracy claim is inferred from public-data licensing.
After scoring this sample is observed; never tune on it and call the next score independent.
